scope: Add the full set of recommended primary literature to the corresponding problem items of docs/architecture/design-kernel-hard-problems.md (items 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9 and the implementation-mapping section) and to the evidence-basis section of docs/architecture/design-editor.md. No production code, schema, test, corpus or numeric contract changed this turn.
documentCoverage: Only literature citations, boundary clauses and mapping bullets were appended; prior research sections, tables and historical ledgers (including design-kernel-research-2026-10-07.json) were not modified.
linkVerification: DOI links verified against Crossref metadata on 2026-10-08; author/institution pages verified by HTTP 200 or web search; IEEE standards and Khronos registry pages reject automated fetches (TLS/403) but are the canonical addresses verified by search; three items have no verified open URL and are cited bibliographically only.

addedReferences.title: IEEE Standard 754-2019 for Floating-Point Arithmetic
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Normative text for correctly rounded basic operations; not evidence that any driver conforms.

addedReferences.title: The OpenGL ES Shading Language (GLSL ES) 3.20, precision/invariance sections
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: WebGL2-side counterpart of the WGSL reassociation rule; invariance qualifiers do not replace the byte-parity contract.

addedReferences.title: Muller et al., Handbook of Floating-Point Arithmetic, second edition
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Rounding/compensation algorithms compendium; vocabulary, not an implementation certificate.

addedReferences.title: Ogita, Rump, Oishi, Accurate Sum and Dot Product (SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 26(6))
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Standard algorithm/error bound for compensated TwoSum dot products; certified_filter.rs belongs to this lineage and may now cite the published bound.

addedReferences.title: Heckbert, Filtering by Repeated Integration (SIGGRAPH 86)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Origin of prefix-sum box convolution; says nothing about Figma's kernel.

addedReferences.title: Crow, Summed-Area Tables for Texture Mapping (SIGGRAPH 84)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Prefix-sum technique origin; not a filter-shape claim.

addedReferences.title: Wells, Efficient Synthesis of Gaussian Filters by Cascaded Uniform Filters (IEEE PAMI 8(2))
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Theory for Gaussian-from-box cascades; candidate model family only, not Figma evidence.

addedReferences.title: Kovesi, Fast Almost-Gaussian Filtering (DICTA 2010)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Cascade order/quality engineering reference; not a byte-parity argument.

addedReferences.title: Loop and Blinn, Resolution Independent Curve Rendering Using Programmable Graphics Hardware (SIGGRAPH 2005 / TOG 24(3))
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: GPU implicit-form curve coverage route; long-term candidate, does not change the current eight-row interval contract.

addedReferences.title: Manson and Schaefer, Wavelet Rasterization (CGF 30(2))
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Coverage in a wavelet basis; candidate for the future analytic coverage experiment only.

addedReferences.title: Catmull, A Hidden-Surface Algorithm with Anti-Aliasing (SIGGRAPH 78)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Coverage-mask lineage; positions the fixed-sample profiles, does not validate them.

addedReferences.title: Carpenter, The A-Buffer, an Antialiased Hidden Surface Method (SIGGRAPH 84)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Per-pixel coverage-bit lineage; historical positioning only.

addedReferences.title: Abram, Westover, Whitted, Efficient Alias-Free Rendering Using Bit-Masks and Look-up Tables (SIGGRAPH 85)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Analytic bit-mask coverage lineage; historical positioning only.

addedReferences.title: Moreton and Sequin, Functional Optimization for Fair Surface Design (SIGGRAPH 92)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Class-A/G2 curve quality reference; cannot substitute for measuring Figma contours.

addedReferences.title: Levien, From Spiral to Spline (PhD thesis, UC Berkeley)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Spiral/spline G2 theory; quality reference frame, not a certified Figma formula.

addedReferences.title: Lane and Riesenfeld, A Theoretical Development for the Computer Generation and Display of Piecewise Polynomial Surfaces (IEEE PAMI 2(1))
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Adaptive subdivision flatness bounds; used to cross-check, not replace, the current chord-distance bound.

addedReferences.title: de Figueiredo, Adaptive Sampling of Parametric Curves (Graphics Gems V)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Practical adaptive sampling bounds; same cross-check role as Lane-Riesenfeld.

addedReferences.title: Perlin, An Image Synthesizer (SIGGRAPH 85)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Original gradient-noise paper; no evidence Figma uses it.

addedReferences.title: Lagae, Lefebvre, Drettakis, Dutre, A Survey of Procedural Noise Functions (CGF 29(8))
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Domain map for candidate elimination; not a selection criterion by itself.

addedReferences.title: Cook and DeRose, Wavelet Noise (SIGGRAPH 2005 / TOG 24(3))
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Band-limited noise candidate avoiding downsampling aliasing; still requires footprint/rounding rules for byte parity.

addedReferences.title: Lagae, Lefebvre, Drettakis, Dutre, Procedural Noise Using Sparse Gabor Convolution (SIGGRAPH 2009 / TOG 28(3))
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Band-limited alternative; same measurement-first caveat.

addedReferences.title: O'Neill, PCG: A Family of Simple Fast Space-Efficient Statistically Good Algorithms for Random Number Generation
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Integer-hash candidate alongside Jarzynski-Olano; statistical quality is not visual matching.

addedReferences.title: Wallace, Merging and Transformation of Raster Images for Cartoon Animation (SIGGRAPH 81)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Second origin of premultiplied compositing; read together with Porter-Duff.

addedReferences.title: ISO 32000-2, Document management - Portable document format - Part 2, chapter 11 (transparency)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Isolated/knockout group model structurally parallel to pass-through groups; no verified open URL, cited bibliographically; standards text not freely redistributable.

addedReferences.title: Stokes, Anderson, Chandrasekar, Motta, A Standard Default Color Space for the Internet: sRGB (v1.10)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Primary sRGB paper (author copy at W3C, marked historical); IEC 61966-2-1 remains normative.

addedReferences.title: Miller and Nezafat, Perceptual Signal Coding for Maximum Dynamic Range (SMPTE Annual Technical Conference)
addedReferences.scopeBoundary: Original PQ proposal, later standardized as ST 2084; no open full text found, cited bibliographically; BT.2100 remains the normative reference.

addedReferences.addedTo: hard-problems item 8 and design-editor evidence section

addedReferences.addedTo: hard-problems item 8 and design-editor evidence section

addedReferences.title: Ulichney, Digital Halftoning (MIT Press)
addedReferences.addedTo: hard-problems item 8 and design-editor evidence section

addedReferences.title: Fogel, Wein, Halperin et al., CGAL Arrangements and Their Applications (Springer)

runtimeTestsThisTurn: Not run; documentation-only literature addition. No Rust, WASM, frontend, GPU or corpus change; prior acceptance ledgers remain the sole runtime evidence.
limits: Citations supply candidate models and formal references; they reveal nothing about Figma private internals.
PQ (Miller/Nezafat 2014), Floyd-Steinberg 1976, Moller 1965 and ISO 32000-2 chapter 11 have no verified open full-text URL and are cited bibliographically.
IEEE standards and Khronos registry pages reject automated fetching; their addresses are canonical per search verification.
No performance, correctness or acceptance claim is transferred from any cited paper to this renderer.
The newly suggested dither/box-cascade hypotheses remain unmeasured; adopting either requires the existing pulse/step-response calibration workflow.
postAdditionCorrections: Corrected the feGaussianBlur box-approximation note attribution: the note with the concrete formula (s>=2.0, d=floor(s*3*sqrt(2*pi)/4+0.5), even-d rule, ~3% error) lives in SVG 1.1 section 15.17 only; Filter Effects Level 1 keeps the element definition without the note. The formula itself was added to both documents as a directly testable hypothesis for blur pulse-response measurement.

Added an evidence-checked Figma engineering reference bullet (Figma Rendering: Powered by WebGPU) recording: C++ to WASM plus native x64/arm64 server-side builds, GLSL single-source compiled through their preprocessor and naga to WGSL/GLSL, load-time readback comparison with dynamic WebGL fallback and device blocklists instead of a byte-parity bar, and planned compute-shader blur/MSAA. Also linked their WASM load-time post and the 2018 per-commit frame-time benchmarking post.
